response.text: {"question":"What risk management and customer due‑diligence requirements must an NBFC implement under RBI guidelines?","answer":"The NBFC must adopt a risk‑based approach for risk mitigation and management, have board‑approved policies, controls and procedures, implement a customer‑due‑diligence programme tailored to its money‑laundering/terrorist‑financing risks and business size, and continuously monitor and improve those controls.","answerable":true}
